tweakswitch.title: TweakSwitch
tweakswitch.incompatible: Made for a different Minecraft version; it may not work correctly.
tweakswitch.importFailed: Some packs could not be imported. Check the log for details.
tweakswitch.vt.title: Vanilla Tweaks Packs (%s)
tweakswitch.vt.selectShown.tooltip: Selects every pack in the list below (use search to narrow it down). Click again to clear them.
tweakswitch.doneHint: Go back to TweakSwitch to switch them on.
tweakswitch.doneHintOn: They're switched on. Click Done in TweakSwitch to apply.
tweakswitch.switchOn.tooltip: On: packs you download come back switched on, and Done on the TweakSwitch screen applies them. Off: they come back off for you to choose.
tweakswitch.someFailed: %s failed. Check the log for details.
tweakswitch.mr.title: Modrinth Resource Packs (%s)
tweakswitch.getVanillaTweaks.tooltip: Pick Vanilla Tweaks packs and download each one as its own switch.
tweakswitch.getModrinth.tooltip: Search Modrinth's resource packs for this version and download them as switches.
tweakswitch.mr.needsPacks: Also downloads the packs it needs: %s
tweakswitch.dp.button.tooltip: Add data packs and crafting tweaks from Vanilla Tweaks, or data packs from Modrinth, to this world. They change gameplay, not textures, so they live here instead of with your resource packs.
tweakswitch.dp.title: Data Packs for This World
tweakswitch.dp.doneHint: They switch on for this world when you click Done.
tweakswitch.mods.title: ⚠ Some packs need mods
tweakswitch.mods.explain: These packs need mods you don't have. Download Mods puts their Fabric versions in your mods folder for you, or click a mod to open its page.
tweakswitch.mods.install.tooltip: Downloads these mods (and any mods they need) from Modrinth into your mods folder, then the packs. The mods work once you restart Minecraft.
tweakswitch.mods.downloadAnyway.tooltip: Downloads just the packs. They may look wrong until you add the mods.
tweakswitch.mods.installed.title: ✔ Mods downloaded
tweakswitch.mods.installed.failed: No Fabric version for this Minecraft version on Modrinth. Open its page to look:
tweakswitch.mods.restart: ⟳ The mods will work once you restart Minecraft.
tweakswitch.mods.continue.tooltip: Downloads the packs. Restart Minecraft afterwards so the mods load.
tweakswitch.getUpdates.tooltip: Check your downloaded packs for newer versions.
tweakswitch.updates.title: Pack Updates
tweakswitch.updates.none: No packs in the TweakSwitch folder yet.
tweakswitch.updates.detail.vanillaTweaks: Vanilla Tweaks packs don't have version numbers. Pick it to download it again and get any changes since you downloaded it.
tweakswitch.updates.detail.noVersion: Installed: %s. Modrinth has no version of this pack for Minecraft %s.
tweakswitch.updates.detail.unknown: This file isn't on Modrinth or Vanilla Tweaks, so it can't be checked for updates.
tweakswitch.group.name: A–Z
tweakswitch.empty.imported: No imported packs. Drop resource pack .zip files on this screen, or put them in the folder (right-click a pack, or ⚙ → Open Folder).
tweakswitch.empty.vanillaTweaks: No Vanilla Tweaks packs yet. Click + Vanilla Tweaks below to pick some.
tweakswitch.empty.modrinth: No Modrinth packs yet. Click + Modrinth below to search for some.
tweakswitch.savedCopy: Couldn't reach the site, so this is the list saved last time.
tweakswitch.error.offline: No internet connection. Check it and try again.
tweakswitch.error.timeout: The site took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.
tweakswitch.error.rateLimited: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
tweakswitch.error.siteDown: The site is having problems right now: %s. Try again later.
tweakswitch.error.notFound: The site doesn't have this for your Minecraft version: %s.
tweakswitch.sort.tooltip: The order of switches inside each group: by name, newest file first, or switched-on packs first.
tweakswitch.sort.name: Name
tweakswitch.delete.title: Delete %s?
tweakswitch.delete.message: This removes %s from your TweakSwitch folder. It can't be undone.
tweakswitch.delete.messageOn: This switches the pack off and removes %s from your TweakSwitch folder. It can't be undone.
tweakswitch.broken.note: damaged or not a resource pack
tweakswitch.broken.tooltip.redownload: Minecraft can't read %s, probably because a download was cut short. Click to download it again, or ✕ to delete it.
tweakswitch.broken.tooltip.delete: Minecraft can't read %s. It isn't from Vanilla Tweaks or Modrinth, so it can't be downloaded again. Click to delete it.
tweakswitch.clash.title: These packs clash
tweakswitch.clash.message: %s changes the same thing as %s, which is switched on. Only one of them can show.
tweakswitch.order.tooltip: Choose which pack wins when two change the same thing.
tweakswitch.order.title: Pack Order
tweakswitch.order.explain: When two packs change the same thing, the one higher in this list wins. Use ▲ and ▼ to move a pack.
tweakswitch.order.empty: No packs are switched on yet. Switch some on, then come back to put them in order.
tweakswitch.order.rowTooltip: ▲ moves this pack up so it wins over the packs below it. ▼ moves it down.
tweakswitch.presets.tooltip: Save your switches as a named set, like "PvP" or "Building", and swap between sets in one click.
tweakswitch.presets.title: Presets
tweakswitch.presets.name: Name a new preset...
tweakswitch.presets.save.tooltip: Saves the packs that are switched on now under the name in the box. A preset with the same name is replaced.
tweakswitch.presets.apply.tooltip: Switches on exactly the packs in %s and switches your other TweakSwitch packs off. ✕ deletes the preset.
tweakswitch.presets.empty: No presets yet. Type a name in the box above, then click Save Current to keep the packs that are on now.
tweakswitch.presets.explain: Click a preset to switch to it. To add one, type a name in the box above and click Save Current.
tweakswitch.presets.tips: Tip: set a key for "Switch to Next Preset" under Controls. To import an exported list, drop its file on this screen.
tweakswitch.presets.delete.title: Delete preset %s?
tweakswitch.presets.delete.message: Only the preset is deleted. Your packs stay where they are.
tweakswitch.export.tooltip: Saves your pack list and which packs are on to a small file, to share with a friend or restore later.
tweakswitch.import.title: Import this pack list?
tweakswitch.import.message:
Packs you already have, switched to match the list: %s
Packs to download from Vanilla Tweaks or Modrinth: %s
Packs that can't be found, skipped: %s
tweakswitch.split.title: Split this Vanilla Tweaks pack?
tweakswitch.split.message: %s is one zip holding %s Vanilla Tweaks. TweakSwitch can download each tweak as its own switch, so you can turn them on and off one by one.
tweakswitch.split.pickedHint: Click Download to get each as its own switch.
tweakswitch.split.pickedSome: Click Download. %s weren't found for this version.
tweakswitch.modUpdate.tooltip: Opens the download page for the newest TweakSwitch.
tweakswitch.modUpdate.hint: Open TweakSwitch for the download link.
tweakswitch.settings.title: TweakSwitch Settings
tweakswitch.settings.section.startup: Checks when Minecraft starts (once a day at most)
tweakswitch.settings.previews.tooltip: Shows a box with pictures and details when you hover a pack. Tapping Shift or clicking ⇧ Preview does the same.
tweakswitch.settings.previewSize.tooltip: How wide the preview box is.
tweakswitch.settings.uiSize.tooltip: Compact fits more on screen. Normal has taller buttons and switches, with each pack's description under its name.
tweakswitch.settings.accent.tooltip: The color of TweakSwitch's own screens. The Vanilla Tweaks and Modrinth screens keep their sites' colors.
tweakswitch.settings.switchOn.tooltip: On: packs you download come back switched on, and Done applies them. Off: they come back off for you to choose.
tweakswitch.settings.clash.tooltip: Asks what to do when you switch on a Vanilla Tweaks pack that clashes with one that's already on, like two crosshairs.
tweakswitch.settings.updateReminder.tool: Checks your packs against Modrinth when Minecraft starts and tells you if any have updates. This sends the SHA-1 hashes of your pack files to Modrinth.
tweakswitch.settings.modUpdate.tooltip: Checks GitHub when Minecraft starts and shows a note on the TweakSwitch screen when a newer TweakSwitch is out.
tweakswitch.settings.keys.tooltip: Opens Controls, where you can change the key that opens TweakSwitch (K) and set one for switching presets.
tweakswitch.settings.folder.tooltip: Opens the folder your TweakSwitch packs are kept in.
tweakswitch.mr.filters.noMods.tooltip: Hides packs tagged as made for mods.
